outcome: Time to first analgesic request after spinal anesthesia
cohort: 44 parturients undergoing cesarean section with spinal anesthesia (22 healthy preterm and 22 severely pre-eclamptic with IV magnesium sulfate therapy)
finding: Intravenous magnesium sulfate therapy in severely pre-eclamptic parturients significantly prolonged the time to first analgesic request after spinal anesthesia compared to healthy preterm parturients.
